The '''Fiberglass Rod''' is a [[Tools|tool]] used to catch [[fish]]. It can be purchased at [[Fish Shop|Willy's Fish Shop]] for {{Price|1800}} upon reaching level 2 [[Fishing]]. It can have [[bait]] but not [[tackle]] attached to it.

The Fiberglass Rod can be given a random [[Forge#Tool enchantments|enchantment]] at the Forge.
